exposure: Conservative management (CM) for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
Planned caesarean hysterectomy (CH) for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
outcome: Cost gained per quality-adjusted life year (QALY)
cohort: A theoretical cohort of 1000 pregnant patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) greater than 20 weeks gestation.
finding: Conservative management was found to be the cost-saving strategy, resulting in fewer hysterectomies, surgical site infections, and deaths compared to caesarean hysterectomy.
